title: Webb County Sheriff's Office Says Emergency Dispatch Line Issues Fixed
excerpt: The Webb County Sheriff's Office said Tuesday, Nov. 24, that technical issues with its emergency dispatch phone line have been fixed. For non-emergency calls, residents can dial 956-436-8602.
content:
The Webb County Sheriff's Office said Tuesday, Nov. 24, that technical issues with its emergency dispatch phone line have been fixed.

Sheriff Martin Cuellar shared the update on the Sheriff's Office Facebook page Tuesday afternoon. The office had said its emergency line was having technical issues and that it would provide updates as soon as the issue was resolved.

For all non-emergency calls, residents can dial 956-436-8602.

The Sheriff's Office announced the fix on its Facebook page Tuesday afternoon.
